values.value: Fees come from the course price list; a branch-specific price takes precedence over the organisation-wide price, and a delivery-mode price over an all-modes price. The price agreed at enrolment is kept on the enrolment: later price changes do not affect it. An invoice falls due {{Setting:Default_Invoice_Due_Days}} days after it is issued unless the branch sets its own due days. Tax is added at the branch tax rate (organisation default {{Setting:Default_Tax_Rate}} as a fraction). Monthly fees are billed automatically each month by recurring billing once the first month has been invoiced by staff. An invoice can be split into instalments by finance; the invoice due date then follows the next unpaid instalment. Discount codes are entered at enrolment; some discounts need finance approval before the enrolment can be invoiced.
